physics-killer-12.title: Special Relativity and Modern Physics
physics-killer-12.goal: Analyze the principles of Special Relativity and Modern Physics and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.
physics-killer-12.material: N'elu larịị e tinyere ndọrọ ígwè abụọ na-eduzi eletrik na-edoghị anya, nha n'etiti ha $\ell=0.5\,\mathrm{m}$, a jikọkwara otu ọnụ na resistor. Nguzogide niile nke okirikiri mejupụtara ndọrọ ígwè, mkpanaka ígwè na-eduzi eletrik, na resistor bụ $2\,\Omega$. Ikpo magnet edoro anya kwụ ọtọ $B=0.5\,\mathrm{T}$ kpuchiri okirikiri niile, ma mkpanaka na-aga n'elu ndọrọ ígwè n'ọsọ edoro anya $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$ n'ntụziaka na-apụ site na resistor. N'ime $0.5\,\mathrm{s}$ mkpanaka ahụ gagoro $2\,\mathrm{m}$, magnetic flux na-agafe okirikiri na-agbanwe site na $\Delta\Phi=B\ell\Delta x$. Kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, ike ọkụ e kpatara na-asọ n'okirikiri, na ịdị ukwuu ike mpụga achọrọ iji debe mkpanaka n'ọsọ edoro anya? (Enweghị esemokwu.)
physics-killer-12.s.s1.prompt: N'elu larịị e tinyere ndọrọ ígwè abụọ na-eduzi eletrik na-edoghị anya, nha n'etiti ha $\ell=0.5\,\mathrm{m}$, a jikọkwara otu ọnụ na resistor. Nguzogide niile nke okirikiri mejupụtara ndọrọ ígwè, mkpanaka ígwè na-eduzi eletrik, na resistor bụ $2\,\Omega$. Ikpo magnet edoro anya kwụ ọtọ $B=0.5\,\mathrm{T}$ kpuchiri okirikiri niile, ma mkpanaka na-aga n'elu ndọrọ ígwè n'ọsọ edoro anya $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$ n'ntụziaka na-apụ site na resistor. N'ime $0.5\,\mathrm{s}$ mkpanaka ahụ gagoro $2\,\mathrm{m}$, magnetic flux na-agafe okirikiri na-agbanwe site na $\Delta\Phi=B\ell\Delta x$. Kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, ike ọkụ e kpatara na-asọ n'okirikiri, na ịdị ukwuu ike mpụga achọrọ iji debe mkpanaka n'ọsọ edoro anya? (Enweghị esemokwu.)
physics-killer-12.s.s1.explain: $\Delta\Phi=B\ell\Delta x=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot2=0.5\,\mathrm{Wb}$, $|\mathcal E|=\dfrac{\Delta\Phi}{\Delta t}=\dfrac{0.5}{0.5}=1.0\,\mathrm{V}$ ($=B\ell v=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot4$, ha kwekọrọ). $I=\dfrac{\mathcal E}{R}=\dfrac{1.0}{2}=0.5\,\mathrm{A}$. Ike magnet mkpanaka na-enweta $F=BI\ell=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot0.5=0.125\,\mathrm{N}$ (n'ntụziaka na-egbochi mmegharị dabere n'iwu Lenz) ma ebe ọsọ edoro anya, ike mpụga bụkwa $0.125\,\mathrm{N}$. Nyocha: ike ọrụ mpụga $Fv=0.125\cdot4=0.5\,\mathrm{W}=I^2R=0.25\cdot2$. Ọ bụrụ na e hapụ $\ell$, $I=1.0\,\mathrm{A}$ (azịza na-ezighị ezi ①); ọ bụrụ na e hapụ $\ell$ n'ọgbakọ ike, $0.25\,\mathrm{N}$ (azịza na-ezighị ezi ②); njehie ịmụba $\mathcal E$ site na $\frac12$ bụ azịza na-ezighị ezi ④.
